examples.japanese: ベッドに{横|よこ}になった。
examples.english: I lay down on the bed.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいベッドは{寝心地|ねごこち}がいい。
examples.english: The new bed is comfortable to sleep on.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちは二{段|だん}ベッドで{寝|ね}ている。
examples.english: The children sleep in bunk beds.

notes:
ベッド (from English "bed") is the standard term for Western-style beds with frames and mattresses. Japanese traditionally sleep on {布団|ふとん} (futon) on the floor.

Common types:
- シングルベッド (single bed)
- ダブルベッド (double bed)
- 二{段|だん}ベッド (bunk bed)
- ソファベッド (sofa bed)
- {折|お}りたたみベッド (folding bed)

Related terms:
- マットレス (mattress)
- ベッドフレーム (bed frame)
- {枕|まくら} (pillow)

Note: In hospitals, ベッド refers to a hospital bed, and ベッド{数|すう} means "number of beds" (capacity).
